name: Analyze Bacterial Growth Curve
description: Analyzes bacterial growth curve data to determine growth parameters such as doubling time, growth rate, and lag phase.
detailed_description: Analyzes bacterial growth curve data to determine growth parameters such as doubling time, growth rate, and lag phase.
when_to_use: When you need analyze bacterial growth curve analysis

parameters.time_points: [Required] Time points of measurements in hours (List or numpy.ndarray)
parameters.od_values: [Required] Optical density measurements corresponding to each time point (List or numpy.ndarray)
parameters.strain_name: [Required] Name of the bacterial strain being analyzed (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Optional] Directory where output files will be saved (default: .)
